name: Kingenta Ecological Engineering Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Kingenta Ecological Engineering Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, produces, and sells agricultural fertilizers and raw materials in China. The company offers various products, such as compound, phosphate, controlled-release, nitro, water soluble, and microbial fertilizers. It also trades, imports, and exports chemical fertilizers, raw materials, pesticides, herbicides, foliar fertilizers, and bio stimulants.
